title: ResourceLoader
key_points: ResourceLoader is a singleton used to load resource files.
It uses ResourceFormatLoader classes to load files into memory and convert them to a format usable by the engine.
You have to import files into the engine first to load them using load().
Non-resource files like plain text cannot be read using ResourceLoader. Use FileAccess instead.
ResourceLoader offers methods for adding, removing and listing resource format loaders.
limitations: Documentation does not cover all possible use cases and edge cases of ResourceLoader.
Some features or methods may require knowledge of the Godot Engine's internal workings to fully understand.
Examples provided in the documentation are limited to specific scenarios and may not encompass the full range of possibilities.
asserts: ResourceLoader is the recommended way to load resource files within the Godot Engine, making use of ResourceFormatLoader classes for efficient file handling and conversion.
scope: The context of these assertions refers specifically to the functionality and usage of the ResourceLoader class within the Godot Engine's architecture and resource management system.
